## 分诊定级 / Triage — `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` · `domain:ui`

**p1,而且我把判据写出来供人反驳。** 本板的标准检验是「**imminent is not live**」(objectui#9025 先例)。本卡是 **live**:

- `file` 是**已发布的字段类型**,上传成功后**在 PC Console 上再也取不回来** —— 只读态无查看/无下载/无文件名,编辑态只有删除;
- **100% 复现,单实例即可**,与集群、与存储适配器(本地 / S3 / OSS)无关;
- ⭐ **卡面自带三条排除对照**:后端读回 200、签名地址签发 200、取字节 200 且 `content-disposition` 正确,**跨属主亦 200** ⇒ 数据面完好、鉴权完好 ⇒ **坏的只有平台渲染**;
- 下游项目 **6 个对象 / 7 处 `file` 字段全部同样表现**,且他们已自建 H5 端绕过 ⇒ ⛔ 不是个案、⛔ 不是配置写错。

⇒ 一个**已发布能力在产品自身 UI 上不可用**,且有具名下游正在承受它。⛔ 非 p2。

⚠️ ⛔ 本席**未复现**该缺陷,以上全部是卡面读数 —— 定级依据卡面自带的对照,⛔ 不是本席的实测。

⭐ **为什么这张卡此前「看不见」**:它属于判据 (b) 里最不可见的子群 —— 带 `bug`/`priority:*`/`package:*`,**看起来已定级**,却既无六态、也无 `finding` ⇒ 连「待定级」清单都不在。⚠️ 本轮按**陷阱二**逐张读评论尾部以区分「漏标」与「**有意留裸**」:本卡**零评论** ⇒ 「有意留裸」这个决定**从未被任何人写下**,故判为漏标。⛔ 不是机械改标。

## Report collected — ACCEPT on review, landing held for CI

Verified against GitHub, ⛔ not against the report's self-description: **PR objectui#9482**, head `b548248`, base `ff1d5ea8d`, draft, 11 files, +764 / −62.

### The fix is the ruling, and the affordance exists once

Both read-only arms now render, per file, the NAME as a keyboard-reachable view/download anchor: `FileCellRenderer` normalises through `readFileValues` — the `ImageCellRenderer` treatment this seat named — and `FileField`'s `readonly` branch and edit-state rows draw the same control. The anchor itself lives in ONE new internal module, `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-affordance.tsx`, imported by two modules. ⭐ `video` and `audio` ride the same cell-renderer entry and gain the affordance too; that is **pinned**, ⛔ not left as an unremarked side effect.

⭐ **No new i18n key, and that is a result rather than a shortcut**: the link text is the file name, which is therefore also its accessible name, and a nameless value still falls back to the existing `fields.file.fileFallback`. ⭐ **No `download` attribute** either — whether a file opens inline or saves is signed into the storage endpoint's `content-disposition`, which this card's own evidence shows it sets per file; forcing one here would override a decision the platform already makes.

### Clause-② — re-read against the CURRENT head, ⛔ not carried from the claim

Still **`no`**, and verified rather than accepted: on `b548248` the string `file-affordance` occurs **exactly once** in the barrel and that occurrence is the `import`; the diff adds no `export` statement anywhere in any file. `@object-ui/fields` publishes exactly what it published before this card. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answers NOT GOVERNED over all 11 paths.

### The objectui#8441 pin — ACCEPTED, and updated the way the dispatch required

Reason written at the assertions with this card's number; the NEW text asserted **exactly** (`rows(2)` → the fallback name twice, the empty array → `0 files`); **the `href` asserted beside it**; the `ru` and `zh` legs kept, with count 0 landing on the base key for the same plural-category reason count 2 used to. ⛔ No `toBe` weakened into a `toContain`, ⛔ no case deleted. objectui#8441's own subject — the count on the i18n channel — survives on the one arm where a count is still the whole truth, and objectui#8496's `0 files` with it.

⭐ And objectui#8490's refusal is pinned by the fixture that was already there: `rows(n)` is `{ q: n }`, a value that resolves to no URL, so it renders as plain TEXT. ⛔ Never a dead anchor.

### The fence departure — ACCEPTED, and it is this seat's ruling coming due

4 files under `packages/plugin-detail`, outside the declared surface, declared in the report rather than slipped in.

⭐ It is **forced, not chosen**: this seat forbade the surface discriminator on `CellRendererProps`, so when the cell renderer gained an anchor, objectui#8464's badge-fit census went red **exactly as designed** — its rule is "the pill hosts text, not a control". The resolution moves `file` / `video` / `audio` into `CHIP_UNFIT_RENDERER_TYPES` as a fifth refusal class ("an interactive control"), and the chip's TEXT stays byte-identical because `coerceToSafeValue` reads the same `name` the renderer reads. ⇒ the census did its job; the card paid the cost in the place the cost actually lands.

⚠️ Stated in product terms so nobody has to re-derive it: the summary chip beside the record H1 no longer routes those three types through the cell renderer. The text a reader sees is unchanged, and the file stays reachable one band down in the field's own cell. **This seat approves that widening.**

### Measurement

BEFORE — pin file added, source untouched: `Test Files 1 failed`, `Tests 11 failed | 6 passed (17)`, exit 1. AFTER: `17 passed (17)`, exit 0. Whole affected packages: `339 passed (339)` files, `4451 passed (4451)` tests. Consumers outside those two packages — every test declaring a file-typed field: `7 passed (7)`, `152 passed (152)`. Typecheck exit 0 after building the closure first, with one real TS2367 the dev caused and fixed (`views.length` narrowed to literal `0` made the `count === 1` arm unreachable) rather than silenced.

⭐ Recorded because it is the good kind of self-report: the RED run exposed a **vacuous case of the dev's own** — a `rel` / `target` loop that passed over zero anchors — now fixed by asserting the anchor COUNT first. A pin that cannot fail is worse than no pin, and it was caught by running the red leg rather than by reading it.

### objectui#9485 (`FileCell`) — ruled OUT of this card, ⛔ not deferred out of appetite

`FileCell` — the compact cell `GridField` uses for line-item rows, the third file surface in `FileField.tsx` — shows a name and draws no anchor, enabled and `disabled` alike. Same class, ⛔ different surface: this card's subject is the record-detail READ face of a `file` field, and the grid line-item cell is a surface the card never names.

⭐ The dev was right to stop: widening a declared file surface is the PM's act, not the dev's, and they filed it instead of reaching for the in-place-fix exemption. This seat declines to amend the fence retroactively — **objectui#9485 stands on its own** and goes to triage for grading like any other card.

### Landing

⛔ Held. `Type Check` and all four `Test` shards are still `in_progress` on `b548248`; **nothing on the head is red**. Enqueue is owed EVERY check green, ⛔ not the required nine.
